components.name: Selector card

Description.default: Courier brings the order within 2 days

components.description: A large, explained choice: plan, delivery method, payment type, onboarding goal. The whole card is the hit target; the indicator (Radio · Checkbox · Switch) shows the selection model. Selected = accent/soft; Hover = fill/soft-hover over surface/card; Error = border/danger 2 px + a Fieldset message. Media: None · Icon (exposed _Icon) · Image start (64) · Image top (280 wide). Group cards inside a F

components.name: Selector group
components.description: 2–4 Selector cards that answer one question. Put it inside a Fieldset (3.19) for the label and the error message. Vertical on Mobile; Horizontal on Web when every card fits ≥ 240 px. Gap scale/12.
